title: Lawyers and students protest in Nagpur against Delhi police actions
seoTitle: Nagpur lawyers protest Delhi police action

tea.why: Protesters demonstrated to condemn alleged police misconduct, mass detentions, and the treatment of advocates during recent Delhi protests.
tea.want: Protect fundamental rights, uphold the rule of law, and preserve democratic traditions against alleged authoritarian suppression.
tea.changed: Oct 12: Lawyers and student bodies staged demonstrations outside the Nagpur District and Sessions Court and Samvidhan Square.

summary: On October 12, 2026, lawyers and student groups held separate demonstrations in Nagpur to protest alleged police misconduct and mass detentions during recent protests in New Delhi. Advocates gathered around the Nagpur District and Sessions Court and Samvidhan Chowk, condemning the treatment of senior advocate Shadan Farasat and other protesters in the national capital. Members of the National Students’ Union of India (NSUI) and the All India Students’ Federation (AISF) also protested at Samvidhan Square in solidarity with students and the CJP. Participants raised slogans against the central government and the CEC, criticizing what they described as growing authoritarianism and the violation of fundamental rights. Speakers emphasized the right to express dissent and called for unity to defend constitutional freedoms.
demands: Protect fundamental rights and constitutional traditions
Safeguard the rights of stakeholders in the justice system
Uphold the rule of law against alleged authoritarian suppression
response: No official government or police response to the Nagpur demonstrations was reported in the sources.

updates.text: Lawyers and student bodies staged demonstrations in Nagpur against alleged police misconduct and detentions in New Delhi.
